snippet.title: Super Robot Wars OG Dark Prison - Neo Granzon (ENG)
snippet.description:
Previous video was removed due to a copyright claim.

Neo Granzon creates black holes via the taking of large amounts of baryonic matter and compressing it until its Schwarzschild radius exceeds its actual radius. It acquires the necessary mass by absorbing baryons from the ether using the halo on its back. The Degeneration Cannon/Shukutaihou functions in two stages:
- Firstly, the enemy is dragged through a dimensional tunnel to a higher dimension. The baryonic mass accumulated in the halo is subjected to nuclear degeneration.
- Secondly, the mass of the artificial white dwarf exceeds its critical limit, causing a runaway nuclear fusion (in essence, a carbon detonation supernova) 

The Schwarzschild radius is the radius of a sphere, where the combination of its mass and density means that its escape velocity is the speed of light. Because not even light can escape it, it is no longer visible. This is a black hole, in essence, a deformation of spacetime. The Schwarzschild radius of an object is proportional to its mass; despite it's enormous size to us, the Earth's is a mere 9 millimeters. And the vast Milky Way galaxy, over 100,000 light years in diameter, has a Schwarzschild radius of less than 0.2ly.

The black holes used during Black Hole Cluster have Schwarzchild radii on the quantum scale and are sheathed in a special gravitational field, allowing them to be launched at the enemy. The Granzon/Neo Granzon do not need to "fly" in the conventional sense, as the orbs on its limbs allow it to manipulate the vector of gravity in relation to itself. In essence, the Granzon can simply "fall" in whichever direction it chooses and attain acceleration by altering its own mass and the strength of the gravity acting upon it. The orblike apertures on the shoulders generate the Distortion Field, a force field that warps the vectors of any kinetic force acting upon it, harmlessly dispersing the energy.
